agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has 2 bodies at maximal G~5 and dt~0.03 (upper limit). Bodies approach from ~3.7 separation to 0.34 (~softening length 0.3) by step 16. Adaptive substeps increase to 28 but leapfrog with large dt accumulates large energy error during close encounter: energy drifts from E0 -405 to -785 at step16, a change of 380 exceeding allowed ~139. Reducing dt to 0.01 with same steps removes violation, confirming timestep/substep resolution is cause, not NaN or momentum.
